Name: 1 in 1000000 Chance for Golden Freddy Jumpscare Every Second
Author: PredatedElk6
Description:
[font=Verdana][size=4]🎤[/size][i] [b][color=#cc4125][size=4]What is this all about?![/size][/color][/b][/i][/font]
[font=Verdana][size=2]For my first Stardew Valley mod, I decided to port [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/balatro/mods/825]1 in 1000000 Chance for Golden Freddy Jumpscare Every Second[/url][/b], which I originally made for Balatro. Hopefully it does not explode or anything. [/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2][b][color=#6aa84f]1 in 1000000 Chance for Golden Freddy Every Second[/color], [/b]this mod adds a rare Golden Freddy jumpscare that may trigger during gameplay, turning even the calmest run into something a little less peaceful;[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2][color=#6aa84f][b]Just like the original[/b][/color][b], [/b]it will not only appear when you least expect it, but [u]it will also crash your game[/u], just like the original;[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2][color=#6aa84f][b]Do you want to know everything about this mod?[/b][/color] Well, that is not really recomented if you want to enjoy the mod at it's fullest, but I can't really stop your curiosity, can't I? Here's the list of all the other things this mod does behind the curtains:[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][spoiler][font=Verdana][size=2][color=#6aa84f][b]Manual Easter Egg[/b][/color], do you remember how, in the original game, you could get jumpscared by Golden Freddy by typing [color=#bf9000]1987[/color] in the Custom Night menu? I added something similar to this mod! Just try pressing a few numbers on your keyboard and let me know what happens. ;)[/size][/font][/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list][font=Verdana][color=#6d9eeb][size=4]💡 [/size][b][size=4]Future Plans:[/size][/b][/color]
At the moment, this mod does exactly what it says: a very rare chance to be caught off guard by Golden Freddy. If interest is high enough, I may consider:[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][b]More polish:[/b] visual and audio refinements if needed;[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Extra variations:[/b] other FNAF-inspired events if they fit the mod's style.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Verdana][i][color=#ffff00][b]⚠️ Disclaimer:[/b][/color] [/i][size=2]I won't be responsible for anything else happening due to this. Use at your own risk.[/size][/font]

[font=Verdana]
[size=4]🔨 [/size][color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b]How to install and use[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Be sure to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] installed, you can check the wiki if you don't know how to do it;[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Extract the [color=#cccccc].zip[/color] file in the following path: [color=#cccccc]SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/color];[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][size=2]Have fun. :)[/size][/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Verdana][size=2][b][color=#6d9eeb]Want to customize your experience? 🤔[/color][/b]
If you want to change how the mod behaves, go to [color=#cccccc]SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\1 in 1.000.000 Chance for Golden Freddy Every Second[/color] and edit the [color=#cccccc]config.json[/color] file to your liking:[/size][/font]
[code]
"IntervalSeconds": 1,
"ActivationChance": 1000000,
"JumpscareVolume": 1.0,
"JumpscareCrashesGame": true,
"DisplayDurationMin": 2.0,
"DisplayDurationMax": 4.0[/code]

[font=Verdana][color=#e69138][size=4][b]❤️ Credits and Thanks:[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Inspired by:[/b] the Golden Freddy appearance from FNaF 1;[/font][/*]
[*][font=Verdana][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/KevFodaci][b]KevFodaci[/b][/url][b],[/b][/font] for suggesting the addition of a config option to toggle whether the jumpscare closes/crashes the game, helping improve the mod; [/*]
[*][font=Verdana][b]Thank you[/b] to everyone who enjoys absurdly low odds and unnecessary panic.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Verdana][i][b]♤ ♧ Enjoy the chaos and let the jumpscare decide your fate! ♡ ♢[/b][/i][/font]
